Omar: Hi all  excited to start today. Quick org question: who signs off on demo environment access (short-lived credentials, sample datasets) for a product demo? Also, if something blocks my onboarding over the weekend, who do I page?

Priyanka: welcome Omar! For demo env access we usually do a fast-path: eng-platform approves capacity + eng-infra issues short-lived creds. CC @Gus for infra.

Gus: hey @Omar :wave: file a ticket in infra-bookings with subject: "demo-access: <your-name>" and add tag `fast-path`. Include demo date/time and datasets needed. We aim to approve within 4 business hours; for urgent weekend approvals ping pager.

Omar: what does "ping pager" mean for onboarding? I don't want to wake folks unless it's critical.

Becky: good question. Non-critical onboarding issues go to #new-hires and we triage during business hours. Critical blockers (e.g., no access to customer demo env right before a live call) use the oncall pager. Use the label `onboard:urgent` in the ticket and include an ETA for the demo so SRE can prioritize.

oncall-bot: PagerPolicy: onboard-urgent -> #eng-oncall (2m). If unacked -> #eng-sre-secondary (10m) -> oncall-manager (30m). Please ensure `onboard:urgent` is used sparingly.

Gus: weekend fast-path: if you absolutely need weekend access, open a ticket and add `weekend:yes` and DM me + Becky. We'll try to issue ephemeral creds (24h) and add a TTL note. Example ticket body to paste: ```name: Omar reason: customer demo date: 2026-06-15 11:00Z env: demo-sandbox datasets: sample-v1 ttl: 24h tags: fast-path,weekend:yes```

Priyanka: Ownership quick map for demos/onboarding: 
- Demo capacity & reservation: eng-platform (Priyanka)
- Short-lived creds & infra playbooks: eng-infra (Gus)
- Data/sample provisioning: product-ops (Becky)
- Weekend critical paging: eng-sre/oncall

Omar: awesome, that helps. Last tiny thing: is there a checklist for "prep day before demo" so I don't miss steps (keys, network allowlist, visuals)?

Becky: yes  we keep a one-pager in the onboarding docs: https://go/redwood/onboard/demo-checklist. It includes network allowlist snippet, how to run a quick smoke test, and who to CC. If anything missing open a PR on the doc.

Omar: perfect, saved. Thanks everyone! Tagging this thread for my notes :raised_hands:
